description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git fast-import and fast-export functionality with various scenarios involving marks files, submodules, and relative paths.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the specified message, used to set up repository states.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Git command-line wrapper used to execute Git commands within the test scenarios.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers, used in loops for creating large marks files.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Configures global Git settings necessary for the tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or inputs.
